figure_candidates.label: Figure 1
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 1. Schematic illustration of terpenoid biocatalytic synthesis and bioorthogonal cross-linking principles. (a) Terpenoid synthesis in Saccharomyces cerevisiae. 
Abbreviations: G6P, glucose-6-phosphate; G3P, glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate; PDH, Pyruvate Dehydrogenase Complex; PDC, Pyruvate decarboxylase; ALD6, Acet­
aldehyde dehydrogenase; ACS, Acyl coenzyme A synthetase; ERG10: acetyl-coenzyme A (CoA) acetyltransferase; ERG13, HMG-CoA synthase; HMGR, HMG-CoA 
reductase; PT, Prenyl-transferase; TS, Terpene Synthases. (b) The in vitro multi-enzyme cascade system for terpenoid synthesis, assembled via biorthogonal chem­
istry. (c) SpyTag/SpyCatcher. (d) SnoopTag/SnoopCatcher. (e) DogTag/DogCatcher. (f) Jo/In. (g) KTag/QTag cross-linking catalyzed by microbial transglutaminase.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 2
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 2. Construction, expression and structural analysis of recombinant enzymes. (a–f) SDS-PAGE analysis (left) and MALDI-TOF-MS (right) of the six purified re­
combinant enzymes. (a) Q-MK-SpC (calculated molecular weight: 46.5 kDa; observed: 46.29 kDa). (b) SpT-PMK-SnC (calculated: 56.3 kDa; observed: 56.0 kDa). (c) 
SnT-PMD-DC (calculated: 55.8 kDa; observed: 55.8 kDa). (d) DT-IDI-In (calculated: 41.4 kDa; observed: 41.8 kDa). (e) Jo-ispA-K (calculated: 45.1 kDa; observed: 
45.1 kDa). (f) Q-FS (calculated: 71.8 kDa; observed: 71.2 kDa). (g–l) Structural overlay of predicted models of wild-type and recombinant enzymes. (g) MK vs. Q-MK- 
SpC (purple vs light green). (h) PMK vs. SpT-PMK-SnC (blue vs green). (i) PMD vs. SnT-PMD-DC (red vs green). (j) IDI vs. DT-IDI-In (orange vs grey). (k) ispA vs. Jo- 
ispA-K (orange vs blue). (l) FS vs. Q-FS (yellow vs deep Magenta).

figure_candidates.label: Figure 3
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 3. SDS-PAGE verification of recombinant enzyme cross-linking. (a) Schematic diagram of bioorthogonal pair cross-linking. (b) SDS-PAGE analysis of cross- 
linking between purified Q-MK-SpC and SpT-PMK-SnC (M, marker; Lane 1, Q-MK-SpC; Lane 2, SpT-PMK-SnC; Lane 3, 2h cross-linking sample). (c) SDS-PAGE 
analysis of cross-linking between purified SpT-PMK-SnC and SnC-PMD-DC (M, marker; Lane 1, SnT-PMK-SnC; Lane 2, SnC-PMD-DC; Lane 3, 2h cross-linking 
sample). (d) SDS-PAGE analysis of cross-linking between purified SnC-PMD-DC and DT-IDI-In (M, marker; Lane 1, SnC-PMD-DC; Lane 2, DT-IDI-In; Lane 3, 2h 
cross-linking sample). (e) SDS-PAGE analysis of cross-linking between purified DT-IDI-In and Jo-ispA-K (M, marker; Lane 1, DT-IDI-In; Lane 2, Jo-ispA-K; Lane 3, 2h 
cross-linking sample). (f) SDS-PAGE analysis of cross-linking between purified Jo-ispA-K, Q-FS and MTG (M, marker; Lane 1, Jo-ispA-K; Lane 2, Q-FS; Lane 3, 2 h 
cross-linking sample). (g) SDS-PAGE analysis of cross-linking between six enzymes (M, marker; Lane 1, Q-MK-SpC; Lane 2, SpT-PMK-SnC; Lane 3, SnC-PMD-DC; Lane 
4, DT-IDI-In; Lane 5, Jo-ispA-K; Lane 6, Q-FS; Lane 7, MTG; Lane 8, 0h cross-linking sample; Lane 9, 0.25 h cross-linking sample; Lane 10, 0.5 h cross-linking sample; 
Lane 11, 1 h cross-linking sample; Lane 12, 2 h cross-linking sample; Lane 13, 4 h cross-linking sample). (h) SDS-PAGE analysis of the supernatant samples before and 
after the six-enzyme cross-linking (M, marker; Lane 1, Q-MK-SpC; Lane 2, SpT-PMK-SnC; Lane 3, SnC-PMD-DC; Lane 4, DT-IDI-In; Lane 5, Jo-ispA-K; Lane 6, Q-FS; 
Lane 7, the supernatant sample before cross-linking; Lane 8, the supernatant sample after 4 h cross-linking).

figure_candidates.label: Figure 5
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 5. Synthesis of β-farnesene. (a) Scheme of β-farnesene catalytic route. (b) GC analysis of β-farnesene standards and reaction products. (c) MS analysis of 
β-farnesene standards and reaction products. (d) Optimization results diagram of reaction conditions (MVA concentration, pH, temperature, Mg2+ concentration, ATP 
concentration). (e) Comparison chart of β-farnesene production in different systems. (f) Cyclic catalysis of the O-CLEs cascade system, relative activity was calculated 
by normalizing the yield of each cycle to that of Cycle 1 (defined as 100%). (n = 3).
